references.text: Naphtali did not drive out the inhabitants of Beth-shemesh and Beth-anath, which are mentioned here as cities in Naphtali's inheritance. This shows that the tribes were not always able to take full control over the assigned cities.
Beth-shemesh is also mentioned as a city on the border of Judah, indicating that there were several cities with this name in Israel.
Some of the cities in Naphtali's territory were later given to the Levites as Levitical cities.
Hormah (Horem) is related to the Hebrew word for ban, which was used for cities devoted to destruction in the struggle for the land.
This verse is part of the complete list of Naphtali's inheritance, which begins here.
